_comment: Sprint D9 — sustained load scenario. Cf. d9_deep_analysis_supplement.md §1.2 (sample sizing). 5 min @ ~10 RPS = ~3000 samples ⇒ p99 IC ~±25 % (acceptable for CI). For ±10 % IC the duration would need to be ~16 min (DT-D9.A1, P3). 4 concurrent clients matches the typical Tokio worker pool dimension.
_connections_explanation: One TCP connection per concurrent client — exposes any per-replica saturation in HPA-scaled deployments. With clusterIP=None (headless service), DNS round-robin distributes connections across replicas.
